generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Deliveries from Nov 2023 (MY2024). 123 kWh pack, 816 V nominal (two 400 V halves paralleled on 400 V chargers); DC up to 250 kW at 400 V, 350 kW at 800 V; native NACS; 11.5 kW (48 A) AC. Long Range RWD sold Apr-Sep 2025 only; Dual Motor AWD (coil springs) for 2026; range extender cancelled. No pack/charging change found, so one generation. EPA rows start at 2025 (no 2024 rows in our EPA import; reason not checked). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Cybertruck ; https://insideevs.com/news/772205/tesla-cybertruck-rwd-discontinued-2025/
